rules.rule: Every fixed literal contributes a DescriptionRecord containing its exact value, type and denotation; this is descriptive lexical content, not an applied clause.

Current focus is latest written nonempty description. Latest completed description is latest completed lexical contribution or typed constructed proposition. A lexeme description is complete as a description, not complete as an argument-saturated predicate.
BOIL NOT FULLY builds prohibition of FULLY(BOIL), retaining all three written lexical dependencies. No cooking execution.

FULLY BOIL after an identical previously prohibited FULLY(BOIL) builds a quoted reprise with that prohibition dependency; without prior norm it is an unsaturated completed-boiling predicate description.

FIRST requests its WATER noun at next bare aiin across one IMMEDIATE_TRANSFER; OTHER requests next bare aiin. Both consume only explicit WATER field returned from retained description plus typed required contexts. No LIQUID-to-WATER narrowing or source-side supplementation.
DescriptionRef projection returns only explicit payload fields. Lexical DescriptionRecords have no WATER field. No source IDs/positions choose content or functions.
